title: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Item-Compatibility Graphs for One-Dimensional Bin Packing
abstract: arXiv:2609.25397v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The one-dimensional bin packing problem (1D-BPP) is a classical NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with applications ranging from logistics and manufacturing to cloud resource management. Although deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has become a competitive paradigm for data-driven optimization, most learned packing methods target 2D and 3D variants, and intelligent learned solvers for 1D-BPP remain scarce. In this paper, we present a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for 1D-BPP. We formulate the packing process as a Markov decision process on an item-compatibility graph, serving as a structural knowledge representation in which every action merges two partial bins that fit together. translated_title: 基于物品兼容性图的一维装箱深度强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 一维装箱问题是经典的NP难组合优化问题，其应用范围涵盖物流、制造业以及云资源管理等领域。尽管深度强化学习已成为数据驱动优化中一种具有竞争力的范式，但现有的大多数学习型装箱方法都针对二维和三维变体，而针对一维装箱问题的智能学习型求解器仍然稀缺。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的端到端、尺寸无关的一维装箱图强化学习框架。我们将装箱过程形式化为物品兼容性图上的马尔可夫决策过程，该图作为一种结构化知识表示，其中每个动作都是将两个相互适配的部分箱子进行合并。图神经网络的actor-critic策略从该表示中提取关系特征，通过强化学习进行训练，并由随机束搜索进行解码，使得单个训练好的模型能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物品兼容性图的端到端、尺寸无关的图强化学习框架，通过图神经网络actor-critic策略和随机束搜索解码，为经典NP难的一维装箱问题提供了新颖的深度强化学习求解方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel end-to-end, size-agnostic graph reinforcement learning framework for the NP-hard one-dimensional bin packing problem, which formulates packing as a Markov decision process on item-compatibility graphs and employs a graph neural network actor-critic policy with stochastic beam search decoding.
